errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
noOrgBody: Register your organisation so we can verify it. Then you can post opportunities.

banner.verifiedBody: You can publish opportunities. Matching students will be notified.
banner.pendingBody: We are checking your details. You can prepare drafts, but you cannot publish until you are verified.
banner.rejectedBody: Fix the details below and contact support to review again.

pending.whyBody: Students and families in rural areas are often targeted by fake fee and placement offers. We check every organisation before it can reach a student.
pending.step1: We check your name, contact details and, for colleges, the AISHE listing.
pending.step2: This usually takes a few working days.
pending.step3: You will get a notification when the decision is made.

org.setupLead: Tell us who you are. We verify every organisation before students can see it.
org.name: Organisation name
org.aboutHint: What you do and who you help, in a few lines.

wizard.typeTitle: What kind of organisation are you?
wizard.typeBody: Pick the one that fits best.
wizard.listingBody: Search the national directory. If you find it, claim the listing to manage it. Otherwise register as new.
wizard.noMatch: No institute found with that name.
wizard.detailsBody: These are shown to students once you are verified.
wizard.verifyNote: We verify every organisation before it can reach students, to protect them from fee scams. You can prepare drafts while you wait.

college.title: College listing
college.body: This is what students see on your college page. Keep fees and seats honest and up to date.
college.noListing: Your college is not linked to a directory listing, so there is no public page to edit yet.

postings.lead: Opportunities you offer to students. Matching students are notified when you publish.
postings.emptyBody: Create your first posting. It stays a draft until you publish it.
postings.needVerified: Your organisation must be verified before you can publish.
postings.publishBody: Students who match the criteria will be notified right away, and the posting will show on matching career pages.
postings.closeBody: Students will no longer be able to see or apply to it.

kpi.notifiedHint: Matching students told about your postings

form.lead: Fill in the sections. You can save a draft and publish later.
form.title: Title
form.freeHint: Switch off if students must pay any fee.
form.feeHint: The full amount a student has to pay. Students always see this.
form.applyUrlHint: Optional. Students can also apply inside ExcelAIt.
form.stateNote: State and district help show this to students nearby.
form.linkedBody: Your posting will appear on the pages of these careers and courses.
form.needTitle: Add a title (3 letters or more)
form.needFee: Enter the fee, or mark it free

crit.income: family income up to {{amount}} a year

applicants.lead: See who applied and move them along. Each change notifies the student.
applicants.noOffersBody: Applicants appear here once you publish a posting.
applicants.emptyBody: When students apply, they will show up here.
applicants.notifyNote: Changing a status sends the student a notification.
applicants.name: Name

admin.lead: Check each organisation before students can see it.
admin.emptyBody: New organisations waiting for a decision will show up here.
admin.checkNote: Check the contact details and, for colleges, that the AISHE code matches the institute. Approving a claim links the listing to this organisation.
admin.reasonPlaceholder: For example: we could not confirm this institute. Please share a registration document.

mod.lead: Review flagged posts, comments waiting for approval, and reports.

home.leadNoOrg: Register your organisation to start posting.
